title: Serve a live office request, later release the office
caption: Mirrors admin-live-office.e2e.ts. Needs a Velexis live account with an available live office and an OTA on a plan with live mode.

steps.title: Owner requests live access
steps.body: Portal → the OTA's Amadeus page → **Request live access**.
steps.expect: The live `velexis` connection is `pending_verification` without an office; audit `amadeus.live_requested`; ops alert e-mail.

steps.title: See it on the dashboard
steps.expect: Row with the OTA name/key and 'Requested' time; **Assign office** links `/tenants/<id>?tab=connections#connection-<id>`.

steps.title: Assign a live office
steps.body: On the 'Amadeus, Live' card pick an available office → **Assign office**.
steps.expect: Connection Active with the office; the request leaves the dashboard; owners get 'Live Amadeus access is ready for <OTA>'.

steps.title: Release after own credentials
steps.body: **Release** → tick '<key> confirmed that no booking with future travel remains on office <id>' → reason → **Release office**.
steps.expect: Without the box: 'Confirm that no booking with future travel remains on the office.'; without a reason: 'Enter a reason of at least 5 characters.'; then the office is Available.
